description:
Most people treat their portfolio like a savings account.

I don’t.

In this video, I break down why I stopped thinking like a traditional investor and started running my portfolio like a business. Earlier in my career, I spent time in private equity, and one thing you learn quickly is this: nobody talks about “stocks.” They talk about cash flow, capital allocation, equity growth, and return on capital.

That’s exactly how I structure my brokerage account today.

I fully invest my income into assets that grow and produce cash flow. My dividends help cover expenses, margin helps me stay fully invested, and over time the goal is simple: build a portfolio that can replace the paycheck.

In this video I walk through my current portfolio update, why short-term market volatility doesn’t change my strategy, how I think about margin, equity, and cash flow, why real estate and private equity are the best analogies for this system, and how to stop thinking like an employee and start thinking like an owner.

If you’ve ever wanted to break free from the traditional paycheck cycle and start building a portfolio that functions like a real business, this video is for you.
